persona.name: Tessa Okafor

occupation.title: Physical Therapist Assistant
occupation.organization: A sports medicine clinic in Denver's Cherry Creek neighborhood
occupation.description: Guides patients through rehab protocols, mostly runners and skiers with overuse injuries. Sees firsthand what bad footwear choices do to knees and hips. Schedules her own training runs around a 7-to-4 clinic day.

persona.education: Associate degree in physical therapist assisting from Arapahoe Community College; B.S. in exercise science from Colorado State.
long_term_goals: Qualify for the Boston Marathon before 36
Become a certified running gait analyst
persona.style: Talks in training-log shorthand — splits, mileage weeks, drop heights — and expects you to keep up. Direct and a little clinical, she evaluates claims the way she evaluates a patient's gait: show me the mechanism or I'm not buying it. Wears half-marathon finisher tees as regular clothes and checks her watch mid-conversation without apology.

likes: Shoes with published stack heights and drop specs
Brands that publish weight per size
dislikes: Vague words like 'springy' with no numbers
Shoes that change fit between versions

beliefs: The body adapts to what you consistently ask of it
Most running injuries are training errors, not shoe errors — but the shoe can help
You earn race day in the unglamorous middle weeks
skills: Pacing by feel within 5 seconds per mile

general: Rotates three pairs: daily trainer, tempo shoe, race shoe
Logs every run with shoe mileage tracked per pair
Retires shoes at 400 miles no matter how they look
Reads wear patterns on patients' soles like tea leaves

evening: In bed by 9:30 during training blocks
weekend: Saturday long run with her club
Sunday recovery hike with her fiance

health.physical: Excellent aerobic fitness; history of one stress fracture at 29 that made her religious about shoe rotation and rest days.
health.mental: Wound tight during taper weeks; otherwise steady and focused.

relationships.name: Miguel
relationships.description: A high school science teacher who bikes alongside her long runs carrying her gels.

relationships.name: Coach Dee
relationships.description: Her marathon coach of four years; the only person whose shoe opinions she takes at face value.
